title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI hooks + quality gating for prompt-set regressions
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: prevent accidental regressions in prompt-set quality and give teams per-prompt visibility in CI. This PR introduces per-prompt CI hooks that run a lightweight eval on changed prompt-sets, gates merges on quality thresholds, and surfaces detailed metrics in CI artifacts. The goal is to catch prompt-specific regressions early without running full eval harnesses on every push.

What this changes: Adds a modular per-prompt hook (eval_harness/ci/per_prompt_gate.py) that: - loads affected prompt sets, - runs a small, fast set of eval metrics (accuracy/precision/coverage/acceptance rate) against the baseline model configurations, - compares results to the stored per-prompt baselines and thresholds, - fails the job when regressions exceed configurable deltas, and - uploads per-prompt artifacts (score diffs, example failures) to CI. Adds integration into the repo-level CI pipeline (ci/pipelines/eval_harness.yml) and a docs page describing thresholds and how to backfill.

Backfill plan: a convenience script to recompute baselines for existing prompt-sets is included (eval_harness/tools/backfill_prompt_baselines.py). This is non-blocking for the PR but recommended before enabling strict gating on legacy sets.

Checklist:
- [x] Per-prompt gating hook implementation
- [x] Unit tests + small integration test running on local harness
- [x] CI pipeline steps to invoke hooks and upload artifacts
- [x] Docs: ci/prompt-quality-gating.md
- [x] Backfill helper script and migration notes

Notes: Thresholds are configurable per-prompt via YAML files next to each prompt set. Default thresholds are conservative to avoid noise. This PR includes a follow-up job (tracked in ENG-1792) to enable stricter thresholds for high-impact prompt-sets after a 2-week observation window.

review_comments: Ethan Nguyen commented: Nice work — I like the conservative defaults. Two asks: 1) make the threshold parsing tolerant of missing fields, 2) add a short-circuit to skip gating for large batches in nightly runs to avoid flakiness.
Author (Maya Chen) replied: Added tolerant parsing and a 'skip_in_nightly' flag. Updated tests to cover missing-threshold cases.
Priya Singh requested changes: Please add metrics emission for per-prompt histogram diffs (so SRE can alert on spike patterns). Also add a short doc blurb on when to relax thresholds.
Author (Maya Chen) reply: Emitting histogram diffs as CI artifacts and added Prometheus metric names to the docs. PTAL.
Rafael Ortega approved: LGTM after test flake fix. Verified CI run artifacts include example failures and diffs.
ci_checks: Integration: partial (fast eval job) — initial run had a timeout on GPU runner, retried and passed
merge_outcome: Merged via squash (squash/merge) by Priya Singh on 2026-02-03. Commit message summarized per-prompt CI hooks and backfill helper.
release_notes:
- Adds per-prompt CI gating to catch prompt-set regressions early.
- Integrates lightweight eval metrics into CI and uploads per-prompt artifacts for debugging.
- Includes a backfill tool to recompute baselines for existing prompt-sets.
- Default thresholds are conservative; teams should monitor metrics during observation window before tightening.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps the default thresholds permissive. Follow-up will enable stricter gating for high-impact prompt-sets after baseline backfill. The per-prompt metrics are instrumented to allow SRE to create alerting rules if regressions cluster across prompt-sets.
